review_type: Independent read-only source and existing execution evidence review; no tests, browser, network or repository writes performed.
review_conclusions: The disabled expression is exactly the pre-existing guard predicate: unknown Policy or an actual independent attempt. Policy owner matching and response invalidation remain unchanged. No permission bypass or queued automatic replay was added.

The delayed-response test uses real unchanged HTTP 200 session responses and records both UI-saved and Policy-unknown. Its RED captures a real enabled click rejected by the old guard; the same single-test source passes after the repair.

The final negative control starts and abandons an actual ungraded independent attempt in a private RestartRuntime. It checks disabled admission, retained dialog, hidden material/file-name DOM, recovered selected filename and parser choice, and new explicit admission. The runtime is closed in finally, isolating its assessment state from the normal suite runtime.
UploadForm remains mounted while suspended and retains its File and parser state in React; only its rendered controls disappear. This change does not clear the existing dialog.

evidence.classification: Target admission RED: enabled entry while Policy unknown; real guard rejected click; release alone did not replay it.
Same complete single-test bytes GREEN after only disabled/title repair.
One PASS and two failures: wrong exact footer expectation, then shared active assessment contaminated the following original Reader test. Not additional product RED.
Final isolated independent assessment control plus admission and unchanged original Reader: three PASS, suite 16.9 seconds.

limitations: This review does not establish the unique historical cause of the ab6 CI failure; the controlled experiment establishes one sufficient path. The later unchanged-software 0484 CI PASS does not erase that failure.

Each owner run binds six declared input paths before and after, not the full repository. The additional RestartRuntime and ImportWorkflow dependency checks here are post-run static bindings to the reviewed commit, not retroactive complete execution inventories.
The selected-file control checks recovered filename, parser selection and upload eligibility. It does not upload the recovered file or claim a server readback proving its bytes.
All execution results belong to the owner runs. This review does not claim a full-suite run or visual screenshot inspection.
